# rapterbox.com

> undiscovered First Edition Holo Originals for people and a local-first
> business twin for operators.

- First Edition / First Dimension: https://rappter.com/
- First Hatch and official market: https://rappter.com/market
- Holodex: https://kody-w.github.io/holodex/
- Business twin and waitlist: https://rapterbox.com/#business
- AI assurance: https://rapterbox.com/wrong-game then https://rapterbox.com/invite
- DOGG: https://rapterbox.com/dogg
- Foundation/product boundary: https://rapterbox.com/rapp
- Open-source RAPP foundation: https://github.com/kody-w/RAPP
- RAPP/1 protocol: https://github.com/kody-w/rapp-1
- Public agent contract: https://rapterbox.com/agent.json

The Holo product and business-box product are separate LLC offers built on the
public RAPP foundation. Detailed internal company doctrine and ownership
administration are private and are not served from this website.
